summary: The US-Iran conflict still dominates: signs that the US may resume strikes after the Nov 3 midterms keep WTI above $100, feeding inflation and Fed hike odds (December hike ~76% in futures, with Musalem and Barkin hawkish on Oct 30). The midterms, the Nov 1 OPEC+ meeting and Israel's hung Knesset add headline risk; the BoJ held on Oct 30.

risks.title: US-Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz closure
risks.status: Oct 30: a top commander briefed Trump on military options and Trump signalled possible strikes after the Nov 3 midterms; Iran's parliament speaker says Tehran's positions won't be compromised, while Tehran confirmed receiving a letter from VP Vance; Hormuz flows far below normal; US blockade of Iranian ports continues
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.market_pricing: Oct 30: WTI 102.95 (+0.9%, +28% over 3 months), Brent 112.33; XLE +1.9% (+3.7pp vs SPY); OVX 57.2 (89th percentile)
risks.impact: Renewed strikes would push oil toward $120 and hurt long-duration equities, transports and the consumer while lifting energy and defense; a deal would do the reverse

risks.title: Fed hiking path and Fed leadership (Chair Warsh)
risks.status: Held 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28 (10-2; Hammack and Cook dissented for a hike); statement upgraded activity to 'strong'; Warsh gave no forward guidance on December
risks.odds: Dec 9 hike 82.6% (CME FedWatch via Fox Business, Oct 28); 90% (fed funds futures, Oct 28)
risks.market_pricing: Oct 30: 10Y 4.929% (-6bp) on a flight to quality; futures Dec hike 76%; Musalem (act 'soon') and Barkin (raise further) hawkish; ECI +0.8% in line
risks.impact: Hot PCE/GDP would cement a December hike and pressure long-duration tech and rate-sensitive groups; benign data would extend the chip rebound

risks.title: US midterm elections
risks.status: Election Nov 3; prediction markets favour Democrats for the House, Senate close; reported Iran strike plans are timed after the vote
risks.odds: Democrats win House ~88%, Senate ~51% (Polymarket via Crypto Briefing, late Oct, exact date unclear)
risks.impact: A split Congress is usually read as gridlock; a Democratic sweep would raise policy uncertainty for health care, energy and taxes; the post-vote window carries geopolitical risk

risks.title: Israel election: hung Knesset
risks.status: With ~90% counted: Netanyahu bloc 53, Eisenkot bloc 48, Arab parties 19 — no bloc at 61; Likud 26 seats, Yashar 21; double-envelope ballots counted from Thursday
risks.market_pricing: No visible oil reaction; Brent driven by Iran strike reports
risks.impact: Prolonged coalition talks or a new election add uncertainty to Gaza/Iran policy; a caretaker Netanyahu government is reportedly keen on strikes

risks.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping
risks.status: Yahoo Finance cited an overnight attack on a Saudi refinery as a driver of oil's Oct 28 rise (details unconfirmed); drones aimed at Riyadh were downed Oct 26
risks.impact: A hit on Saudi export infrastructure (Yanbu, the Red Sea alternative to Hormuz) would be a major oil shock

risks.title: OPEC+ output policy
risks.status: Core seven kept November output at September levels (Oct 4); August output ~5 mb/d below prewar; next meeting Nov 1
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.market_pricing: WTI 101.94; US crude stocks 4% below the 5-year average
risks.impact: A surprise increase would be bearish oil and energy stocks; continued restraint keeps the supply squeeze in place

risks.title: Russia-Ukraine war and peace talks
risks.status: Local truce in one town from Oct 27; trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia technical talks planned in Abu Dhabi in the first half of November (Kremlin: ~Nov 10)
risks.impact: Real progress would be mildly bearish for defense and European gas; a collapse keeps the defense theme supported

risks.title: China-Taiwan tensions and chip export controls / tariffs
risks.status: Chinese live-fire drills across multiple seas in mid-October (not an encirclement of Taiwan); a report says US tariffs on Chinese chips are delayed to June 2027 (unconfirmed date)
risks.market_pricing: SMH -7.5pp vs SPY over 1 month, mostly rates/AI-capex driven
risks.impact: New export curbs or a Taiwan blockade drill would hit semis first; a trade thaw would help

risks.title: Bank of Japan decision and yen
risks.status: Oct 30: BoJ held at 1.25% as expected, raised its inflation forecast and said it is ready to hike if needed; yen ~157 per dollar
risks.impact: A surprise hike could unwind yen carry trades and pressure high-valuation tech; a dovish hold weakens the yen further

risks.title: US government funding / shutdown risk
risks.status: A September report says a stopgap CR funds the government through Dec 11 at FY2026 levels (an earlier bill text said Dec 4; not reconfirmed); the next cliff is in December
risks.impact: A December lapse would delay economic data and dent Q4 growth; markets have usually looked through short shutdowns
